purpose: Test question-only factual decomposition for fallback and assertion without adding AST facts, changing thresholds, or expanding the corpus.

factual_composition.silent-failure-fallback: Maximum of complete discarded-result, fallback-conversion, and success-conversion violation patterns.
factual_composition.weakened-test-assertion: Maximum of complete ordering, exactness/multiplicity, error-detail, and comparison-strength loss patterns.

constraints: Each factual signal compares the supplied before and after behavior.
Each factual signal describes a complete violation, so any one may trigger the rule.
Permission remains separate and uses the minimum of exact-scope and implementation-completeness signals.
Permission questions are evaluated in a separate request so factual question count and framing cannot influence permission scores.
Thresholds remain unchanged during this experiment.
No AST-derived facts or new benchmark cases are introduced.
